correctness.rationale: For independent rate-one clocks the next effective flip is uniform among vertices disagreeing with at least two neighbors; its cut decrement is one or three, giving an exact acyclic probability calculation. Both nonempty stable classes have minimum induced degree two and thus size at least six; a seven-set would consist of a hexagon and an extra vertex that cannot have two hexagon neighbors by girth six. A hexagon and its complement are stable, with six cross edges. For three seeds the monotone two-neighbor closure excludes consensus-plus and all mixed states except for noncollinear same-shore triples. In their six-cycle, a lost original seed cannot be recovered before another bridge involving it activates, which itself requires that seed. The success race has factors 3/6, 2/5, 1/3. A separate exact script, /workspace/evidence/reproduce_heawood.py, built Fano incidence by binary dot products, propagated Bernoulli-sector mass forward in decreasing cut order across all 16,384 states, and reproduced all fifteen rational sums, the q-polynomial, the fixed-state census, each of the 364 three-seed probabilities, the p=1/2 fraction and the 83.04 ratio. Positive polynomial coefficients imply strict increase then decrease through q=p(1-p). The finite exhaustion proves the numerical coefficients for this graph, not for other kinetics or graphs.
